release_notes: LeadForge 2.0 Reference Synchronization, 150-GEO Validation Engine, Local PHP Landings Macro Resolution & Complete Integration Guides. Integrates the 150-country GEO validation dataset with mobile operator prefixes and 33-language localized messages; universal order.php handler supporting 10 CPA networks and automated E.164 phone normalization; output buffering macro substitution for local PHP landings and offers ({subid}, {sub1}, {click_id}); comprehensive localized setup guides and copyable redirect URIs for Google Ads, TikTok, and Facebook integrations across all 7 supported languages.
